item.title: Hello, Blog
item.description: First post. Why I added a blog to my portfolio.
item.content:encoded: Hello World, Motivated by the fast paced changes that the tech world is witnessing right now, I have decided to start my own blog. I do not know right now what I will be posting here, but it will be along the lines of tech, the things that I am learning right now and some of my personal opinions about random things, and more (If I get to do more, then why not) Let's have fun together.
